info.title: ADO simulator
info.description: ADO simulator: a subset of the Azure DevOps Boards REST API 7.1 with its own data store. Authenticate with a personal access token (Basic auth with the token as password, or Bearer). Paths after /_apis/ are case-insensitive. Known differences from real ADO: contract/differences.md.
